name: IPhone 6

images.credit: https://icon-park.com/author/kos/, CC BY 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Discontinued: 2016-09-07 (except India and United States), 2018-09-12 (United States and India)

Body.Other: FaceTime audio- or video-calling, Voice over LTE

Platform.Operating system: Original: iOS 8#8.0, iOS 8.0, Current: IOS 12, iOS 12.5.8, Unofficial: IOS 13, iOS 13

Display.Display: 6: 4.7 in Retina HD: LED-backlit IPS LCD, 1334×750 px resolution (326 ppi) (128 px/cm) pixel density, 16:9 aspect ratio, 1400:1 typ. contrast ratio, 6 Plus: 5.5 in Retina HD: LED-backlit IPS LCD 1920×1080 (401 ppi) (158 px/cm) pixel density, 16:9 aspect ratio, 1300:1 typ. contrast ratio, All models: 500 cd/m² max. brightness (typical), with dual-ion exchange-strengthened glass

Cameras.Rear camera: 6: 8 MP (3264×2448 px max), True Tone flash, f/2.2 aperture, 1080p HD video recording (30 fps or 60 fps), slow-motion video (720p 120 fps or 240 fps)
Cameras.Front camera: 1.2 MP (1280×960 px max), 720p video recording (30 fps), f/2.2 aperture

Sound.Sound: Mono speaker, 3.5 mm stereo audio jack

Battery.Battery: 6: 3.82 V 6.91 W·h (1,810 mA·h) lithium polymer battery, 6 Plus: 3.82 V 11.1 W·h (2,915 mA·h) lithium polymer battery
